versions.title: Subjects & Exam Boards
changes: Create subjects with an exam board (AQA, Edexcel, OCR, WJEC, CIE, SQA, CCEA)
Card sets are grouped under their subject on the home screen
Subject groups are collapsible — tap to expand or collapse, view is saved
Each subject shows total cards, sets, and overall mastery progress
AI Revision Assistant now knows the subject and exam board — tailors questions and explanations to the specific board style and mark scheme
Subject and exam board shown on the set detail screen

versions.title: Redesigned AI Revision Assistant
changes: AI assistant now creates real flashcards — no more chat interface for card generation
Generate questions, Focus on weak cards and Find gaps produce cards you can add to your set or save as new
New AI Quiz mode generates brand new questions in the familiar quiz format
Explain a card and Revision tips remain as a chat interface

versions.title: School Year & Changelog Improvements
changes: Set a school year (Y7-Y13) per card set, shown as a badge on the home screen
Default school year setting in Settings
AI tailors language and difficulty to the school year
Changelog now shows only the latest version with option to expand full history

versions.title: Updates & Changelog
changes: Automatic and manual update settings
Changelog popup shows what changed after an update

versions.title: AI Safety & Polish
changes: AI Revision Assistant stays focused on the current card set only
Added message length limit to AI chat input

versions.title: AI Revision Assistant
changes: AI Revision Assistant powered by Claude via secure Cloudflare proxy
Password-protected access — your API key stays secure on the server

versions.title: Dictation
changes: Microphone button on card editor — speak your term or definition instead of typing

versions.title: Voice Picker & French Support
changes: Automatic French language detection
Voice picker and speed control in Settings

versions.title: Streaks & Text-to-Speech
changes: Study streak counter on home screen
Text-to-speech with speaker button on cards

versions.title: Initial Release
changes: Flashcard, Learn, Quiz and Match study modes
Progress tracking, import, backup and restore
Offline support, no ads, no account required
